clauses.description: At least one availability SLO (ratio-type SLI).
At least one latency SLO (threshold or distribution SLI).
A third, domain-specific SLO beyond availability and latency (4+ SLOs total).
Every declared SLI is referenced by at least one SLO.
OTel Collector pipeline declares an `otlp` receiver.
`service.name` listed in otel.resource_attributes.required.
OTel SemConv version >= 1.26.0 (binding floor).
OTel SemConv at currently-tracked version (1.27.0).
At least five required resource attributes declared.
`otel.sdk.log_correlation: true` (trace IDs injected into logs).
Pipelines export metrics.
Pipelines export logs and traces.
Pipelines include a tail_sampling processor.
spec.telemetry.backends covers metrics + logs + traces.
tier-1 backends pin a `min` version with `gating: enforce`.
Every extended surface references a declared telemetry backend or explicit external ref.
Every SLO has at least one recording rule materialising its SLI.
At least one derived view (e.g. golden signals or per-tenant rollup).
At least one dashboard declared (service overview).
A second dashboard (SLO burn) on top of service overview.
Service overview + SLO burn + deployment overlay + customer impact (4+ dashboards).
Every SLO has at least one burn-rate alert with multi-window policy.
At least one forecast declared on a primary availability SLO.
SEV1 route includes a voice channel.
At least one self-healing remediation declared.
Regression gate set to a release-blocking mode.
At least one synthetic check declared.
Every SLO is the steady-state hypothesis of at least one chaos experiment.
At least one chaos experiment scheduled monthly+ in staging.
At least one chaos experiment runs weekly+ in production with OTel-instrumented synthetic probes.
